title: A grant on a foreign table, where RLS is not merely absent but impossible

expect.note: the table snapshot reads relkind 'r'/'p' and never saw this relation at all, so no rule graded the grant before

fix: Expose the foreign table through a view that carries the filter and grant on the view instead, or push the filter to the remote side. Adding RLS is not an option here — Postgres refuses it on a foreign table — so the usual A2 remedy does not apply.
